_metadata.description: Manual, precise overrides for payees that automated name-matching gets wrong — chiefly contractors/consultants the district pays under a personal name, which otherwise look like employee expense reimbursements. Keyed by person-match-key (GIVEN SURNAME, uppercased — matches every spelling, including 'Surname, Given'). Each entry maps the payee to its real counterparty name and spend category. Add entries as operators identify them; this is intentionally manual (not a heuristic) for accuracy.

SUSAN FORKER.note: Project manager paid under her own name for Green Environment Inc. (per Board President) — contractor spend, not an employee reimbursement.
